environment.description: Production Celery worker running on ECS Fargate. Database connection uses role 'celery_worker' which has been granted full DML privileges (SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE) on all application tables including users, data_exports, and bulk_reports. APP_MASTER_KEY is stored in AWS Secrets Manager but the same secret value is shared across web tier and worker tier. Redis broker has no AUTH configured, accessible from within VPC.

config.database_grants: GRANT SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA public TO celery_worker
config.key_management: single APP_MASTER_KEY in Secrets Manager shared across services
config.network: VPC-internal, no additional segmentation between web and worker subnets
